assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has associated symptoms of palpitations (R42).
The patient has unexplained shortness of breath/dyspnea (R00.2).
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmias and to assess for rhythm disturbances contributing to the patient's clinical presentation.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptomatic palpitations and dizziness in the context of the known cardiac condition.
